note: Triennial election of the Donaghadee Urban District Council (North Ward four seats, South Ward five), polling day 17 May 1967. No contest in either ward: eight nominations for nine seats, so one North Ward seat was left to be filled by co-option. Three candidates for four seats; one seat vacant pending co-option. The Telegraph describes all eight candidates as Independent; the News-Letter prints no labels, so none are given. Returned unopposed.
